inputs.description: Add a clear disclaimer to the simulated capacity data. The capacityService.ts uses Math.random() for fake occupancy. Changes: (1) In ShelterPopup.tsx, add a small info icon/text next to the capacity bar that says "Estimated" (Hebrew: "הערכה") with a tooltip explaining this is not real-time data, (2) In SearchPanel.tsx shelter list items, add a similar small "est." badge near capacity indicators, (3) Add the translations to src/i18n/translations.ts for both languages, (4) Style the disclaimer text to be subtle but readable. Do NOT remove the capacity feature - just clearly label it as estimated.
inputs.title: Label Simulated Capacity Data
